generated_getters.semantics: Stored epoch USDG WAD budget. Zero is the unsnapshotted sentinel; views then use live cap. math.zero_guard: Only netAmount==0 rejected. price/payoutWad/usdgOutRaw can be zero. Zero-payout fill can succeed subject to dependencies even if active()==false from zero capacity. Positive cap can snapshot on zero-output fill; zero cap remains sentinel.
math.non_full_precision_operations: price backing*9850, live liquid*100, filled addition and epoch subtraction checked256-bit; not all math uses mulDiv.
math.residual: payoutWad-usdgOutRaw*factor in[0,factor-1] per fill; consumes WAD budget without USDG transfer. Sum per-fill floors, never floor aggregate WAD to infer cash.
math.maximum_budget_limited_input: For price>0, floor(((remaining+1)*1e9-1)/price), capped at uint256 max, using off-chain arbitrary precision. This only models floor payout<=remaining, not funding or execution; price==0 has no budget-derived bound.

internal_helpers.name: _epochIndex

internal_helpers.name: _liveCap
internal_helpers.detail: 1% of Treasury liquid USDG WAD only, not RFV/Morpho/LP; checked multiplication.

internal_helpers.name: _capacityRemaining
internal_helpers.detail: Nonzero stored cap frozen; otherwise live cap; saturating subtraction at zero. Other epochs never carried forward.

treasury.semantics: spendUsdg requires wired and isSpender[caller], reads raw USDG cash, withdraws exact shortfall from immutable ERC4626 vault to itself, emits MorphoWithdrawn, transfers requested raw USDG to seller checking Boolean, emits UsdgSpent(caller,to,raw). No InverseBond budget check or final balance-delta check in Treasury. Vault withdrawal can fail; code comment cannot guarantee liquidity. liquidUsdg=balance*cached factor; backing=0 for zero NET supply else floor(rfv*1e9/supply). Obtained source rfv=floor(MorphoWad*9800/10000)+liquid+polRfv. Preserve user-validated subtract-floor haircut and establish block-specific source/runtime applicability; do not silently replace arithmetic. polRfv uses NET raw*1e9 and quote raw*factor, floor sqrt, then LP fraction. One-time deployer wiring accepts arbitrary nonzero spender arrays; comment naming InverseBond is not permission evidence.
treasury.scope: Actual obtained body inspection and separately recorded runtime identity match; not independent dependency compilation, historical permissions or settlement proof.

net.semantics: transferFrom spends gross allowance (maxuint infinite allowance unchanged), then checks sender gross balance. Tax only when enabled, neither endpoint exempt and either endpoint mapped; floor(gross*500/10000) to taxCollector, optional Transfer+TaxCollected then remaining Transfer. Burn is permissionless from caller, balance>=gross, reduces caller balance and totalSupply, Transfer(caller,zero,gross); no tax or Treasury-only burn restriction. InverseBond does not measure receipt. A taxed pull can make burn revert absent pre-existing NET; pre-existing donations may cover shortfall, so successful burn does not prove seller delivered gross. Initial wiring can pre-map addresses and grant exemptions; current/historical map/exemptions need evidence.
net.scope: Actual obtained body inspection and separately recorded runtime identity match; not independent dependency compilation, historical permissions or settlement proof.

oracle.semantics: Complete PairOracle body reviewed: constructor caches pair ordering and10^(27-USDGdecimals), no observations seeded.16slots; checkpoint ignores zero reserves/spacing<1800, stores timestamp bucket modulo16 with counterfactual cumulative. TWAP scans newest nonzero observation aged>=1800, rejects none or age>14400, computes wrapping cumulative difference/elapsed then floor(avgUQ112*priceScale/2^112), rejects zero. _currentCumulative extrapolates selected pair cumulative from current reserves over wrapping uint32 timestamp delta. No spot-vs-TWAP deviation guard. InverseBond calls read only; oracleGate has no checkpoint, no keeper operation performed.
oracle.scope: Actual obtained body inspection and separately recorded runtime identity match; current oracle observations require fresh reads.

genesis.semantics: finalizeTime is public uint64 storage initially0; finalize requires wired, not finalized, hard cap hit OR deadline passed with min raise. Sets finalized and timestamp then atomically transfers Treasury share, mints/seeds pair, mints purchaser escrow, enables staking/bonds/tax and checkpoints oracle. Any later failure rolls timestamp back. No finalizeTime setter/reset. InverseBond uses timestamp, not finalized bool or staking.epoch; successful finalization does not ensure oracle has a sufficiently aged valid observation.
genesis.scope: Actual obtained body inspection and separately recorded runtime identity match; not independent dependency compilation or a full historical finalization audit.
